e5a6f670-8be3-4ddc-baee-2ecc307df25d.name: Clara
e5a6f670-8be3-4ddc-baee-2ecc307df25d.description: Beautiful, kind-hearted noble lady who is passionate about singing and dancing.
e5a6f670-8be3-4ddc-baee-2ecc307df25d.personality: Kind-hearted, passionate, loves music and dance.

aca2a052-a1f4-42b1-8e42-b9a666323a57.name: Revellion
aca2a052-a1f4-42b1-8e42-b9a666323a57.description: Massive crimson scaled dragon, 200 feet long with massive jaws and a long spiked tail.

38986452-9f12-44ec-b339-a029f8096546.name: Marius
38986452-9f12-44ec-b339-a029f8096546.description: Knight known for loyalty, bravery, and honesty.

1fdcf488-6b60-4b1c-9b90-79ff1a5e83b0.name: Elara
1fdcf488-6b60-4b1c-9b90-79ff1a5e83b0.description: A seasoned human mercenary, 28‑year‑old swordswoman and scout known for her agility, keen perception, and silent efficiency in the field.
1fdcf488-6b60-4b1c-9b90-79ff1a5e83b0.personality: Pragmatic and disciplined, Elara approaches challenges with cool calculation; she is observant, cautious yet confident in her combat skills, and prefers action over chatter. Her low‑key demeanor hides a steadfast reliability and a quiet determination.
1fdcf488-6b60-4b1c-9b90-79ff1a5e83b0.appearance: Athletic, lean build with lithe muscles, standing around 5'7"; short, dark hair cut practical, sharp greenish‑gray eyes, a light dusting of battle‑scars across her forearms, and a weather‑worn complexion from years outdoors.
1fdcf488-6b60-4b1c-9b90-79ff1a5e83b0.mannerisms: Often scans her surroundings before speaking, keeps her hand near the hilt of her sword, habitually tightens or adjusts her gear, and moves with light, deliberate footwork.
1fdcf488-6b60-4b1c-9b90-79ff1a5e83b0.speech_style: Direct and economical, speaking in concise sentences without ornament, using matter‑of‑fact language and occasional military shorthand.

2a03a29a-412d-4acf-bd09-f84e07582312.name: Garrick
2a03a29a-412d-4acf-bd09-f84e07582312.description: Broad-shouldered, practical human blacksmith known for his solid build and reliable craftsmanship.
2a03a29a-412d-4acf-bd09-f84e07582312.personality: Practical and methodical, he values efficiency and tangible results, approaching tasks with steady focus and a dependable, no‑nonsense attitude.
2a03a29a-412d-4acf-bd09-f84e07582312.appearance: A muscular, broad‑shouldered man in his mid‑thirties with a soot‑stained complexion, short dark hair kept practical, calloused hands, and a faint scar across his left forearm.
2a03a29a-412d-4acf-bd09-f84e07582312.mannerisms: Often wipes his hands on his apron, taps his hammer against the anvil when thinking, and maintains a steady, deliberate posture while speaking.
2a03a29a-412d-4acf-bd09-f84e07582312.speech_style: Direct and concise, using plain language and avoiding unnecessary flourish, his tone is steady and slightly gruff but courteous.

c0792e97-2a82-47ae-b90b-ddb4c676f0cf.name: Tomas
c0792e97-2a82-47ae-b90b-ddb4c676f0cf.description: Human male farmer, patient and hardworking, who tends his fields with steady determination.
c0792e97-2a82-47ae-b90b-ddb4c676f0cf.personality: Patient, hardworking, and dependable, with a methodical approach to tasks and a quiet confidence in his abilities.
c0792e97-2a82-47ae-b90b-ddb4c676f0cf.appearance: Medium build, average height, sun‑tanned skin, short brown hair with a faint beard, calloused hands, and keen, observant eyes.
c0792e97-2a82-47ae-b90b-ddb4c676f0cf.mannerisms: Works methodically, often pausing to run his thumb over the soil before planting; speaks slowly and thinks before answering; hums a low tune while tending the fields.
c0792e97-2a82-47ae-b90b-ddb4c676f0cf.speech_style: Calm and measured, using plain, straightforward language; speaks with a quiet confidence and a hint of rural colloquialism.

c1ce00ca-82e7-4568-8ac2-59b72e24838a.name: Mira
c1ce00ca-82e7-4568-8ac2-59b72e24838a.description: A 30‑year‑old human hunter, renowned for her keen tracking abilities, sharp observation, and solitary independence.
c1ce00ca-82e7-4568-8ac2-59b72e24838a.personality: Observant and independent, Mira is methodical, patient, and prefers solitary work; she trusts her own judgments and remains calm under pressure.
c1ce00ca-82e7-4568-8ac2-59b72e24838a.appearance: Lean, wiry build; around 5'7" tall; sun‑kissed skin; dark brown hair pulled back in a practical knot; sharp amber eyes; a faint scar crossing her left cheek.
c1ce00ca-82e7-4568-8ac2-59b72e24838a.mannerisms: Often pauses to scan the surroundings before moving; habitually checks her bow string and quiver; walks with light, deliberate steps; tilts her head slightly when listening closely.
c1ce00ca-82e7-4568-8ac2-59b72e24838a.speech_style: Direct and economical, speaking in short, factual sentences; avoids unnecessary small talk; tone is steady and unembellished.

97fbf0c4-70e5-4455-b39d-c2d35ff9bc46.name: Borin
97fbf0c4-70e5-4455-b39d-c2d35ff9bc46.description: A disciplined dwarf guard, steadfast and stubborn, who upholds the law with unwavering resolve.
97fbf0c4-70e5-4455-b39d-c2d35ff9bc46.personality: Disciplined and stubborn, Borin is methodical, dutiful, and reliable, favoring order and routine; he is blunt, unflinching in duty, and slow to accept change, though his steadfastness earns respect.
97fbf0c4-70e5-4455-b39d-c2d35ff9bc46.appearance: Short and heavily built dwarf with a broad, muscular frame; dark, weathered skin; thick brazen beard braided down his chest; cropped brown hair; deep-set hazel eyes; a prominent scar across his left cheek; sturdy shoulders; the guard's insignia etched onto his forearms.
97fbf0c4-70e5-4455-b39d-c2d35ff9bc46.mannerisms: Maintains a rigid, upright stance; habitually checks his shield and armor for any flaw; scans the surroundings with keen eyes; taps his foot when waiting; corrects procedural errors with a firm tone.
97fbf0c4-70e5-4455-b39d-c2d35ff9bc46.speech_style: Gravelly, direct, and formal; uses concise sentences and dwarven idioms; speaks with a steady, authoritative cadence, rarely wasting words.

774b5245-39b6-45aa-92ae-c99f33b145f5.name: Lena
774b5245-39b6-45aa-92ae-c99f33b145f5.description: Lena is a 28‑year‑old human healer, recognized for her calm, practical approach to caring for others.
774b5245-39b6-45aa-92ae-c99f33b145f5.personality: Calm and practical, with a methodical mindset; compassionate yet unsentimental, she prefers reliable solutions and steady routines.
774b5245-39b6-45aa-92ae-c99f33b145f5.appearance: Average‑height, slender build; warm brown eyes; dark hair usually kept neat; soft, unblemished complexion; a faint, healed scar on the left hand.
774b5245-39b6-45aa-92ae-c99f33b145f5.mannerisms: Smooths her hands when examining wounds, pauses briefly to consider details before speaking, maintains steady eye contact, and often offers a gentle touch on a patient's forearm for reassurance.
774b5245-39b6-45aa-92ae-c99f33b145f5.speech_style: Measured and straightforward, using clear, concise language without unnecessary flourish; her tone is gentle yet confident.

9033fb0c-98cb-4bd5-8ef7-a4e676f25071.name: Cael
9033fb0c-98cb-4bd5-8ef7-a4e676f25071.description: Cael is a tall, lithe elf scout noted for his constant alertness and reserved demeanor.
9033fb0c-98cb-4bd5-8ef7-a4e676f25071.personality: Alert and reserved, with a keen eye for detail, disciplined patience, and a preference for quiet observation over unnecessary chatter.
9033fb0c-98cb-4bd5-8ef7-a4e676f25071.appearance: Tall and lithe, with angular elven features, pointed ears, and sharp green eyes that constantly scan the surroundings; his hair is long and silvery, falling loosely around his shoulders.
9033fb0c-98cb-4bd5-8ef7-a4e676f25071.mannerisms: Frequently glances over his shoulder, moves silently and deliberately, keeps a hand near his bow, and often pauses to listen before speaking.
9033fb0c-98cb-4bd5-8ef7-a4e676f25071.speech_style: Concise and measured, speaking in low, controlled tones and favoring brief, factual statements over elaborate conversation.
